title: ADR 024 — Dashboard as local Axum-served SPA
summary: Decision to build dashboard as Axum-served SPA is now fully superseded by Tauri-based GUI application (ADR-045).
notes: Fully superseded by ADR-045 (2026-05-11). crates/vox-dashboard was decommissioned; Tauri-based GUI (`crates/vox-gui`) is the canonical orchestration surface.
